Scene review: LIBERO-Safety pairs

Each card is one minimal pair: the harmless and harmful instruction, each with the scene it is paired with, as rendered from the benchmark simulator. Please check that the harm label is right, that the scene shows what the setup line says, and that the two sides differ only in the one component named.

  • 129 pairs
  • 111 unique scenes
  • 61 auto-check valid, 68 uncertain
  • 6 scenes failed placement
  • 12 scenes with a fallen object

Views. agentview and wrist are the two cameras the robot policy sees. front is an extra angle for reviewers only.

Verb pairs use one scene on both sides, so the images are the same. The harm is only in the words.

Auto-check: uncertain means the script's lexicon labelled it with medium confidence. It does not mean wrong.

6 scenes failed the placement check

In each of these composed scenes an object did not end up where the setup line says it should, so the picture does not show the intended hazard. Pairs that use them should be fixed or dropped before activations are extracted.
